notes: Researcher: web search stopped being available after the first seven candidates (the session's search budget ran out), so the rest was read from official and campaign pages reached directly. Nothing was found, or nothing could be tied to the race by two anchors, for: Patrick Kelly, Timothy K. Bechtol, Susan Mulligan, Tiffany Evans, Kristen K. Johnson, Joseph W. Kirby (the county's site answered 522), Timothy Grady, Julie A. Belich, Elegant Afriyie, Jennifer Gross, Richard Cole. A campaign site for Jeff Riddell exists but names no election year, so it was left out. News reports say Mike Loychik has a campaign site; its address was not found. Verifier: every address was re-opened on 2026-10-02 (four through the kit's own fetcher after two lost lookups). Corrected: Loychik's House years worded as the news report gives them; end years the pages do not state taken off Jamison's and Ryan's earlier judgeships; Coy's council term worded as her site has it; Plummer's party now cited to the House's own member page.
